'''Keeper''' was a title in the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]] given to those [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] who oversaw satellite [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]-processing facilities for [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. [[Agruss/Legends|Agruss]] served as the Keeper of the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
